title: Privacy Policy
A1: I. What is this privacy policy?
descriptionA1: We clearly explain what data we use in the SafeMountain app and why.
descriptionA2: UNED (Universidad Nacional de Educación a Distancia). You can contact us at infouned@adm.uned.es or reach out to the Data Protection Officer at dpd@adm.uned.es.
A3: III. What data do we collect and why?
descriptionA3: We only see what apps you have installed to help you identify if any could risk your privacy. We don’t see or access your photos, messages, or files.
A4: IV. Why can we use your data?
descriptionA4: Because you give us permission when using the app. If you're a minor, your parents or guardians must approve. We may also use some data for security, but never in a way that harms you.
A5: V. How long do we keep your data?
descriptionA5: Only as long as needed to analyze the apps. Then, we delete or anonymize it. You can ask us to delete it anytime.
A6: VI. Do we share your data?
descriptionA6: We don’t sell your data or share it with companies or social media. We’ll only share it if legally required (e.g., by a judge).
A7: VII. What rights do you have?
descriptionA7: You can ask to see, change, or delete your data. You can also tell us not to use it. Write to UNED or visit https://sede.uned.es. If you're not satisfied, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency at www.aepd.es.
descriptionA8: Yes. We use encryption and strong security measures. We don’t use cookies. Your data stays on your device unless you agree to send it for analysis.
